author: Michael Crowe
title: How to Play Chess by Michael Crowe
description: Michael Crowe's guide provides a comprehensive overview of chess, including the rules, strategies, and tactics for both beginners and intermediate players. The book is a valuable resource for anyone looking to improve their chess skills and deepen their understanding of the game. It covers essential rules, opening strategies, mid-game tactics, and endgame techniques, making it a practical guide for players of all levels.
